summary: The change retains the raw catalog body separately and reapplies enrichment during 304 revalidation. The focused regression test verifies that a narrower window replaces the prior widened value.

evidence: src/catalog/store.ts stores the raw input body in separate source chunks with integrity metadata.
src/catalog/index.ts revalidates from cached.source_body rather than the enriched served body.
tests/openrouter-catalog.test.ts verifies a window decreases from 1,050,000 to 872,000 after revalidation.
